class.name: NetwActionContext
class.brief_description: The server-side request context of one [NetwAction].

method.name: bind
method.description: Binds [param node] so its [member NetwEntity.entity_id] confirms this action when the authoritative spawn arrives. Call it before adding the node to the tree.

method.name: deny
method.description: Denies this action and asks the requesting peer to revert it. Idempotent.

members.member: The server tick that ran the authority method.
The tick the requester originally asked the server to evaluate, before clamping.
The peer id that sent the request.
The tick used for server validation, clamped to the executing tick.
